verification_methodology.disclosure: The trailing luggage strap is modeled as an articulated multi-link chain attached to the carried suitcase; the luggage stand is a free rigid body on the lobby tiles. Snagging and dragging arise purely from MuJoCo link-to-stand contact and Coulomb friction.
